newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile brewery CCU 1H sales volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Chile brewery CCU 1H sales volume rises.

text.p: Chile's largest beer-maker Compania Cervecverias Unidas (CCU) reported that its first half sales volume rose to 4.45 million hectoliters, up 8.9 percent on the same period last year.
The figures showed sharpest growth in wine sales abroad by CCU's San Pedro wine-maker which climbed 67 percent in the first six months of the year to 86,000 hectoliters.
This was followed by beer sales from CCU's Argentine division which rose 53 percent to 658,000 hectoliters, said the statement.
